blocks.text: Memo: oil sample on fleet PM, not only on a noise

This is the working cut for RDW-MEM-2023-091 on July 6, 2023. Hank Morel asked for a written bound after the current path (Sample kit in a drawer for 'serious' jobs) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Shop Helper, writing for Cal Dreher, Nina Soto, and Hank Morel. Primary host parts.ridgeway.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on sample only when it is already loud, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Fleet PM gets a sample every other oil change. Knocking engine still gets one, but that is late. Cost is on the RO. I am not restating a hallway yes. sample only when it is already loud is out because June 8 loud sample showed fuel dilution we could have caught two PMs ago. $0.0 extra on the kit vs a late engine. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: every=2, kit=0.0, weeks=2, loud=1, dilution=1, drawer=1, fleet=1, late=1. Sibling tickets RDW-3088 and RDW-SOP-2022-011. I will not reopen sample only when it is already loud in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Nina Soto is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

What a skeptical lead would try first on parts.ridgeway.internal: the path Hank Morel actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour.
